_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF ConceptScheme profile UML. The profile is defined at metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifConceptScheme/schema.yaml. ConceptScheme is a standalone SKOS-only profile (no composes:) — a thin wrapper around skosConceptScheme. Distinct from cdifCodelist: looser concept shape (no inScheme requirement on top concepts; notation as array; altLabel/note/version added), and no schema:identifier PropertyValue / dateModified / license machinery. The Anchors package re-declares CatalogRecord so the diagram can show the required https://w3id.org/cdif/conceptscheme/1.1 conformance constraint as an attribute on the schema:subjectOf > CatalogRecord node.

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF ConceptScheme Profile
targetModel.subTitle: SKOS concept schemes used as controlled vocabularies in CDIF metadata
targetModel.definition: CDIF profile module for SKOS concept schemes used as controlled vocabularies in CDIF metadata. Thin wrapper around skosConceptScheme. Required attributes per the profile JSON schema: ConceptScheme has @type (containing skos:ConceptScheme), skos:prefLabel, skos:definition, skos:hasTopConcept (minItems 1); Concept has @type (containing skos:Concept), skos:prefLabel, skos:notation. The catalog record (schema:subjectOf > CatalogRecord) MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/conceptscheme/1.1.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Profile module for SKOS concept schemes used as controlled vocabularies in CDIF metadata.

package.name: Classes
package.definition: Classes of the CDIF ConceptScheme profile: ConceptScheme (the SKOS scheme) and Concept (the SKOS Concept members).

package.name: Anchors
package.definition: Stub re-declarations of CDIFCore classes that this profile attaches to. Provided so the diagram can render attachment edges without dragging in the full CDIFCore class graph.

class._comment: skos:ConceptScheme - a controlled vocabulary expressed as a SKOS scheme. Required by the profile schema: @type (containing skos:ConceptScheme), skos:prefLabel, skos:definition, skos:hasTopConcept (minItems 1). sourceClass=ConceptSystem preserves the DDI-CDI 1.1beta provenance link (same source class as cdifCodelist's ConceptScheme).
class.definition: A SKOS Concept Scheme - a controlled vocabulary aggregating one or more SKOS Concepts. Required attributes: @type (containing skos:ConceptScheme), skos:prefLabel, skos:definition, skos:hasTopConcept (at least one). The metadata record describing this scheme (schema:subjectOf > CatalogRecord) MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/conceptscheme/1.1.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - URI identifier for this concept scheme.

attribute.name: prefLabel
attribute.definition: skos:prefLabel - preferred lexical label for the concept scheme. Required. May be a plain string or a language-tagged value (LanguageTaggedValue is collapsed to String per the union-type policy).

attribute.name: altLabel
attribute.definition: skos:altLabel - alternative lexical labels (acronyms, abbreviations, spelling variants).

attribute.name: definition
attribute.definition: skos:definition - formal explanation of the meaning or purpose of this concept scheme. Required.

attribute.name: notation
attribute.definition: skos:notation - classification code or notation for this concept scheme.

attribute.name: note
attribute.definition: skos:note - general note about the concept scheme.

attribute.name: version
attribute.definition: schema:version - version identifier for the concept scheme.

class._comment: skos:Concept - a SKOS Concept member of a scheme. Required attributes per the profile schema (top-concept items): @type (containing skos:Concept), skos:prefLabel, skos:notation. Concepts MAY also carry definition, note, skos:inScheme back-pointer, and hierarchical broader/narrower links. Unlike cdifCodelist's Concept, inScheme is NOT required on top concepts here.
class.definition: A SKOS Concept member of a ConceptScheme. Must have @type (containing skos:Concept), skos:prefLabel, and skos:notation. Optionally carries skos:definition, skos:note, skos:inScheme (back-pointer to its scheme), and hierarchical skos:broader / skos:narrower links to other concepts.

attribute.name: prefLabel
attribute.definition: skos:prefLabel - preferred lexical label for this concept. Required.

attribute.name: notation
attribute.definition: skos:notation - classification code for this concept within a scheme. Required.

attribute.name: definition
attribute.definition: skos:definition - formal explanation of the meaning of this concept.

attribute.name: note
attribute.definition: skos:note - general note about this concept.

class._comment: CatalogRecord stub - the metadata-about-this-resource node sitting under schema:subjectOf. Typed as schema:Dataset with schema:additionalType narrowing to dcat:CatalogRecord. dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/conceptscheme/1.1. Full definition is in CDIFCore.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::CatalogRecord (the metadata-about-the-metadata node carried at schema:subjectOf on a ConceptScheme). For the conceptScheme profile, dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/conceptscheme/1.1.

attribute.name: additionalType
attribute.definition: schema:additionalType - additional type assertions for the catalog record node. MUST include 'dcat:CatalogRecord' (the @type array itself is typed as schema:Dataset, with this attribute narrowing the role).

attribute.name: conformsTo
attribute.definition: dcterms:conformsTo - URIs of specifications this metadata record conforms to. MUST include the constant https://w3id.org/cdif/conceptscheme/1.1 for the conceptScheme profile.

attribute.name: about
attribute.definition: schema:about - @id back-pointer to the ConceptScheme this CatalogRecord describes (closes the schema:subjectOf round-trip).

association._comment: ConceptScheme -> CatalogRecord via schema:subjectOf. The attachment point for the cdif:conceptscheme/1.1 conformance declaration.
association.definition: schema:subjectOf - the catalog record describing this concept scheme's metadata. For a CDIF concept scheme, the CatalogRecord MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/conceptscheme/1.1.

association._comment: ConceptScheme -> Concept via skos:hasTopConcept. Required: every CDIF ConceptScheme must declare at least one top concept (minItems 1).
association.definition: skos:hasTopConcept - top-level concepts with no skos:broader in this scheme. Required; the array must be non-empty.

association._comment: Concept -> ConceptScheme via skos:inScheme. Optional in this profile (unlike cdifCodelist where it is required on every concept).
association.definition: skos:inScheme - the ConceptScheme(s) this concept belongs to. Optional in the conceptScheme profile (the containment via skos:hasTopConcept implies it for top concepts; required only when the concept reference is by @id outside a containing scheme).

association._comment: Concept -> Concept via skos:broader. Parent (broader) concepts in the hierarchy. Items in the schema are inline concept objects or @id references; both collapse to a Concept link in the UML.
association.definition: skos:broader - parent (broader) concepts in the hierarchy.

association._comment: Concept -> Concept via skos:narrower. Child (narrower) concepts; inverse of skos:broader.
association.definition: skos:narrower - child (narrower) concepts in the hierarchy. Each inline child SHOULD also declare skos:broader pointing back to this parent.
